messages:
support-bot: FYI cust-opal reporting sustained throughput degradation on Dedicated pool 'dd-ops' since ~16:05 UTC. Ticket OPS-1142 created. p95 up, queues growing, errors still low — requesting eng-runtime triage.

emma: jumping in 5. Console shows p95 on dd-ops rose from ~110ms -> ~420ms at 16:03. Req/s ~35% under baseline. Heatmap points to dd-ops-02.

ryan: @deploy-bot any runtime deploys to dd-ops-02 in the last hour?

deploy-bot: Deployed runtime-service v4.12.3 to dd-ops group (including dd-ops-02) at 15:58 UTC by @ci/cd. No automatic rollbacks.

akash: can someone SSH dd-ops-02 and grab a short profile + top/iostat and per-worker kv cache stats? suspect kvcache churn causing queue buildup.

maria: on it. grabbing logs now. seeing repeated lines at ~16:02 with lots of kvcache misses.

maria: logs snippet pasted:
```
[16:02:11] runtime INFO req=xyz123 p99=430ms cmd=generate
[16:02:11] runtime WARN kvcache miss shard=3 prefix=0x9f1b
[16:02:11] runtime INFO queue_len=48 worker=7
```

emma: queue_len ~48 is the symptom. normally <10. @akash can you run the 30s profiler and enable KV debug for 60s? use bastion helper.

akash: running profiler now and turning on KV trace for 1m. helper cmds:
```
rdw-ctl ssh dd-ops-02 -- sudo /opt/redwood/runtime/bin/profile --duration 30 --out /tmp/opal.prof
rdw-ctl fetch /tmp/opal.prof > /tmp/opal-dd-ops-02.prof
```

maria: KV trace being streamed to s3: s3://rdw-dump/opal/1827609800/kvtrace-dd-ops-02.log

akash: profile uploaded to s3: s3://rdw-dump/opal/1827609800/profile-dd-ops-02.pb. quick sample shows most samples in attention kernels and worker serialize path:
```
attention::fused_forward    510
worker::serialize_output    240
grpc::send                 95
```

emma: attention time spike suggests kernel choice change or quant path regression. dd-ops-02 is A100-80GB like the rest, so hardware mismatch unlikely.

ryan: any recent changes to kernel selection heuristics in v4.12.3? could an experimental selector be active. @akash

akash: There was an experimental change to pick fused_attention_v2 for seq_len <= 64 behind a flag. It should've stayed gated but the flag appears to have been toggled for dd-ops by CI during the rollout.

emma: let's force the legacy selector on that host and restart workers one-by-one to avoid impact. env override: RUNTIME_KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy. Do a rolling restart of workers and watch queues.

akash: applying env override and restarting workers sequentially. after first worker restart queue dropped from 46 -> 14 and p95 fell to ~170ms. continuing roll.

maria: informing customer: "Engineers investigating increased latency on your Dedicated pool. Mitigation in progress; will update shortly." :hourglass_flowing_sand:

akash: after full worker roll p95 back to ~130ms and throughput returned to expected levels.

ryan: will flip the config flag in config service to prevent future involuntary toggles. flag key: feature.runtime.kernel_shortseq_v2. Pushing change to dd-ops group now.

deploy-bot: Config change applied: feature.runtime.kernel_shortseq_v2=false to dd-ops at 16:34 UTC.

maria: updating ticket OPS-1142 with timeline, links to artifacts, and mitigation steps. attaching s3 artifacts.

akash: root cause summary: leaked experimental kernel selector for short sequences in v4.12.3 led to degraded fused_attention performance for Opal's sequence distribution on A100 hosts. Mitigation: host-level env override + config toggle.

emma: follow-ups assigned:
- akash: add perf telemetry for attention kernel selection by host + submit small canary PR for selector change
- ryan: add a deploy-pipeline guard to prevent feature flag leakage and include selector opt-in in canary policy
- maria: finalize customer comms and post-incident notes in OPS-1142

maria: customer updated at 16:48 UTC with mitigation summary and ETA ~72h for code changes.

support-bot: Noted. OPS-1142 marked engaged with eng-runtime. Please attach PRs and s3 links to the ticket when available.

ryan: opening PR for canary today, will tag @security and @qa for review.

akash: thanks all. closing thread once PRs and ticket updated.
